text: The hallmark of chaos that makes long-term prediction impossible is:
choices: sensitive dependence on initial conditions (exponential separation of nearby trajectories)
convergence of all trajectories to a single fixed point
explanation: Chaos is marked by sensitive dependence: nearby initial conditions separate exponentially (a positive Lyapunov exponent), so tiny uncertainties are amplified and defeat long-term prediction even though the system is deterministic. Chaos requires nonlinearity.
